plugin.name: PlantUML Importer
plugin.description: Imports PlantUML diagrams as real Visual Paradigm models and diagrams: ER (crow's foot), class, use case, sequence, activity, state machine, component, deployment and object diagrams.

action.label: Import PlantUML File
action.tooltip: Import PlantUML diagrams (.puml) of any type: ER, class, use case, sequence, activity, state, component, deployment, object

action.label: Paste PlantUML Code
action.tooltip: Paste PlantUML code (@startuml ... @enduml) and import it
